instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. Fuel cost is primarily pass-through under capacity purchase agreements with major airline partners (United, Delta, American, Alaska and others). SKYW bears fuel risk only on pro-rate operations.

warnings: Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to major airline partners under capacity purchase agreements. Effective January 1, 2002, contracts with major partners obligate partners to bear economic risk of fuel price fluctuations. No hedging program.
